title: Certificates
subtitle: TLS certificate management — CA, server certs, CSR and CA transition

overview.caExported: CA exported — write it to each slave's /etc/mtl/ssl/mtl-ca.pem.

upload.title: Upload Certificate
upload.subtitle: CA needs only PEM; SERVER needs PEM + private key.
upload.keyNote: The private key is stored on disk with 0600; it is never written to the database.
upload.serverNeedsKey: A private key is required for a SERVER certificate.

csr.title: Generate CSR
csr.subtitle: The private key is generated on the master and stays on disk; only the CSR is exported.
csr.fillRequired: Name and Common Name are required.
csr.resultNote: CSR created. Download it, get it signed by your corporate CA, then upload the returned certificate via 'Upload Certificate'.
csr.resigned: Signed with MTL CA — certificate added to inventory.

transition.title: CA Transition
transition.subtitle: Activate a new CA + server certificate atomically (together).
transition.warning: A CA change affects replication. Slave nodes cannot verify the master until the new CA is distributed. After activation, export the CA and copy it to every slave.
transition.noCa: No activatable CA. Upload the corporate CA first.
transition.noServer: No valid SERVER certificate with a key. Upload one first.
transition.chainNote: The server certificate must chain to the selected CA; otherwise activation is safely rejected (rollback).
transition.selectBoth: Select both a CA and a server certificate.

activate.title: Activate Certificate
activate.description: '{{name}}' will be activated: the live file is swapped, slapd is restarted and nginx is reloaded. If verification fails, it is rolled back automatically.

delete.title: Delete Certificate
delete.description: This certificate will be permanently removed from the inventory. Type its name to confirm.
